content.text:
Below is the opportunities API response that `ConnectOpportunitiesParser` reads, written as XML. The server actually sends a JSON array; each XML element is a JSON key. The attributes give the model field it fills (`field`), the type, and whether it is required (`required="true"` means a missing key throws `JSONException`). [Certain] — I took this from the `fromJson` methods in `ConnectJobRecord`, `ConnectPaymentUnitRecord`, `ConnectAppRecord` and `ConnectLearnModuleSummaryRecord`.

```xml
<!-- Response root: JSON array; each element -> ConnectJobRecord -->
<opportunities type="array" model="List<ConnectJobRecord>">
  <opportunity model="ConnectJobRecord">
    <id                         field="jobId"            type="int"     required="true"/>
    <opportunity_id             field="jobUUID"          type="string"  required="true"/>
    <name                       field="title"            type="string"  required="true"/>
    <description                field="description"      type="string"  required="true"/>
    <short_description          field="shortDescription" type="string"  required="true"/>
    <organization               field="organization"     type="string"  required="true"/>
    <start_date                 field="projectStartDate" type="date"    required="true"/>
    <end_date                   field="projectEndDate"   type="date"    required="true"/>
    <max_visits_per_user        field="maxVisits"        type="int"     required="true"/>
    <daily_max_visits_per_user  field="maxDailyVisits"   type="int"     required="false" default="NO_DAILY_LIMIT"/>
    <budget_per_visit           field="budgetPerVisit"   type="int"     required="true"/>
    <budget_per_user            field="totalBudget"      type="int"     required="true"/>
    <currency                   field="currency"         type="string"  required="true"/>
    <deliver_progress           field="completedVisits"  type="int"     required="true"/>
    <is_active                  field="isActive"         type="boolean" required="false" default="true"/>
    <is_user_suspended          field="isUserSuspended"  type="boolean" required="false" default="false"/>

    <verification_flags type="object" required="false" nullable="true">
      <form_submission_start field="dailyStartTime"  type="string" required="false" default=""/>
      <form_submission_end   field="dailyFinishTime" type="string" required="false" default=""/>
    </verification_flags>

    <!-- A unit that fails to parse is logged and skipped; it does not fail the job -->
    <payment_units field="paymentUnits" type="array" required="true">
      <payment_unit model="ConnectPaymentUnitRecord">
        <id              field="unitId"   type="int"    required="true"/>
        <payment_unit_id field="unitUUID" type="string" required="true"/>
        <name            field="name"     type="string" required="true"/>
        <max_total       field="maxTotal" type="int"    required="true"/>
        <max_daily       field="maxDaily" type="int"    required="false" default="NO_DAILY_LIMIT"/>
        <amount          field="amount"   type="int"    required="true"/>
        <!-- derived: jobId, jobUUID copied from parent job -->
      </payment_unit>
    </payment_units>

    <!-- Present and non-null => claimed=true; values override top-level fields -->
    <claim field="claimed" type="object" required="false" nullable="true">
      <max_payments overrides="maxVisits"      type="int"  required="false"/>
      <end_date     overrides="projectEndDate" type="date" required="false"/>
      <date_claimed field="dateClaimed"        type="date" required="false"/>
      <payment_units type="array" required="false">
        <payment_unit>
          <payment_unit_id matches="ConnectPaymentUnitRecord.unitUUID" type="string" required="true"/>
          <max_visits      overrides="ConnectPaymentUnitRecord.maxTotal" type="int" required="true"/>
        </payment_unit>
      </payment_units>
    </claim>

    <learn_progress type="object" required="true">
      <total_modules     field="numLearningModules"       type="int" required="true"/>
      <completed_modules field="learningModulesCompleted" type="int" required="true"/>
    </learn_progress>

    <learn_app   field="learnAppInfo"    model="ConnectAppRecord" isLearning="true"  required="true"><!-- see AppRecord --></learn_app>
    <deliver_app field="deliveryAppInfo" model="ConnectAppRecord" isLearning="false" required="true"><!-- see AppRecord --></deliver_app>

    <!-- Client-side derived (not from JSON):
         status: AVAILABLE; LEARNING if learning% > 0; DELIVERING if also claimed
         paymentAccrued="", deliveries/payments/learnings/assessments = empty lists -->
  </opportunity>
</opportunities>

<!-- Shape of learn_app / deliver_app -->
<AppRecord model="ConnectAppRecord">
  <cc_domain     field="domain"       type="string" required="true"/>
  <cc_app_id     field="appId"        type="string" required="true"/>
  <name          field="name"         type="string" required="true"/>
  <description   field="description"  type="string" required="true"/>
  <organization  field="organization" type="string" required="true"/>
  <passing_score field="passingScore" type="int"    required="true"/>
  <install_url   field="installUrl"   type="string" required="true"/>
  <learn_modules field="learnModules" type="array"  required="true">
    <learn_module model="ConnectLearnModuleSummaryRecord">
      <id            field="moduleId"     type="int"    required="true"/>
      <slug          field="slug"         type="string" required="true"/>
      <name          field="name"         type="string" required="true"/>
      <description   field="description"  type="string" required="true"/>
      <time_estimate field="timeEstimate" type="int"    required="true"/>
      <!-- derived: moduleIndex = array position, lastUpdate = now, jobId/jobUUID from parent job -->
    </learn_module>
  </learn_modules>
  <!-- derived: jobId, jobUUID from parent job; isLearning from which key it came under -->
</AppRecord>
```

**How errors are handled:**
- If one opportunity fails to parse, it is logged and skipped. The parser still stores every opportunity that did parse, and only then throws `JSONException`.
- A payment unit that fails to parse is dropped and the rest of the job is kept (`ConnectPaymentUnitRecord.java:86`). Any other missing required key fails the whole opportunity.
- An empty response body stores nothing and returns an empty list.

## Overview

`ConnectOpportunitiesParser` reads a JSON array of opportunities and maps each element to a `ConnectJobRecord`. The XML below mirrors that JSON: each element is a JSON key, and its attributes describe how the parser handles it.

| Attribute | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `field` | Model field the key fills |
| `type` | Expected JSON type |
| `required` | `true` = a missing key throws `JSONException` |
| `default` | Value used when an optional key is missing |
| `overrides` | Field that a value under `claim` replaces |
| `model` | Record class the object maps to |

Sources: `ConnectJobRecord.fromJson`, `ConnectPaymentUnitRecord.fromJson`, `ConnectAppRecord.fromJson`, `ConnectLearnModuleSummaryRecord.fromJson` in `app/src/org/commcare/android/database/connect/models/`.

## Data model

```xml
<!-- Response root: JSON array; each element -> ConnectJobRecord -->
<opportunities type="array" model="List<ConnectJobRecord>">
  <opportunity model="ConnectJobRecord">
    <id                         field="jobId"            type="int"     required="true"/>
    <opportunity_id             field="jobUUID"          type="string"  required="true"/>
    <name                       field="title"            type="string"  required="true"/>
    <description                field="description"      type="string"  required="true"/>
    <short_description          field="shortDescription" type="string"  required="true"/>
    <organization               field="organization"     type="string"  required="true"/>
    <start_date                 field="projectStartDate" type="date"    required="true"/>
    <end_date                   field="projectEndDate"   type="date"    required="true"/>
    <max_visits_per_user        field="maxVisits"        type="int"     required="true"/>
    <daily_max_visits_per_user  field="maxDailyVisits"   type="int"     required="false" default="NO_DAILY_LIMIT"/>
    <budget_per_visit           field="budgetPerVisit"   type="int"     required="true"/>
    <budget_per_user            field="totalBudget"      type="int"     required="true"/>
    <currency                   field="currency"         type="string"  required="true"/>
    <deliver_progress           field="completedVisits"  type="int"     required="true"/>
    <is_active                  field="isActive"         type="boolean" required="false" default="true"/>
    <is_user_suspended          field="isUserSuspended"  type="boolean" required="false" default="false"/>

    <verification_flags type="object" required="false" nullable="true">
      <form_submission_start field="dailyStartTime"  type="string" required="false" default=""/>
      <form_submission_end   field="dailyFinishTime" type="string" required="false" default=""/>
    </verification_flags>

    <!-- A unit that fails to parse is logged and skipped; it does not fail the job -->
    <payment_units field="paymentUnits" type="array" required="true">
      <payment_unit model="ConnectPaymentUnitRecord">
        <id              field="unitId"   type="int"    required="true"/>
        <payment_unit_id field="unitUUID" type="string" required="true"/>
        <name            field="name"     type="string" required="true"/>
        <max_total       field="maxTotal" type="int"    required="true"/>
        <max_daily       field="maxDaily" type="int"    required="false" default="NO_DAILY_LIMIT"/>
        <amount          field="amount"   type="int"    required="true"/>
        <!-- derived: jobId, jobUUID copied from parent job -->
      </payment_unit>
    </payment_units>

    <!-- Present and non-null => claimed=true; values override top-level fields -->
    <claim field="claimed" type="object" required="false" nullable="true">
      <max_payments overrides="maxVisits"      type="int"  required="false"/>
      <end_date     overrides="projectEndDate" type="date" required="false"/>

          <payment_unit_id matches="ConnectPaymentUnitRecord.unitUUID" type="string" required="true"/>
          <max_visits      overrides="ConnectPaymentUnitRecord.maxTotal" type="int" required="true"/>
        </payment_unit>
      </payment_units>
    </claim>

    <learn_progress type="object" required="true">
      <total_modules     field="numLearningModules"       type="int" required="true"/>
      <completed_modules field="learningModulesCompleted" type="int" required="true"/>
    </learn_progress>

    <learn_app   field="learnAppInfo"    model="ConnectAppRecord" isLearning="true"  required="true"><!-- see AppRecord --></learn_app>
    <deliver_app field="deliveryAppInfo" model="ConnectAppRecord" isLearning="false" required="true"><!-- see AppRecord --></deliver_app>

    <!-- Client-side derived (not from JSON):
         status: AVAILABLE; LEARNING if learning% > 0; DELIVERING if also claimed
         paymentAccrued="", deliveries/payments/learnings/assessments = empty lists -->
  </opportunity>
</opportunities>

<!-- Shape of learn_app / deliver_app -->
<AppRecord model="ConnectAppRecord">
  <cc_domain     field="domain"       type="string" required="true"/>
  <cc_app_id     field="appId"        type="string" required="true"/>
  <name          field="name"         type="string" required="true"/>
  <description   field="description"  type="string" required="true"/>
  <organization  field="organization" type="string" required="true"/>
  <passing_score field="passingScore" type="int"    required="true"/>
  <install_url   field="installUrl"   type="string" required="true"/>
  <learn_modules field="learnModules" type="array"  required="true">
    <learn_module model="ConnectLearnModuleSummaryRecord">
      <id            field="moduleId"     type="int"    required="true"/>
      <slug          field="slug"         type="string" required="true"/>
      <name          field="name"         type="string" required="true"/>
      <description   field="description"  type="string" required="true"/>
      <time_estimate field="timeEstimate" type="int"    required="true"/>

  </learn_modules>
  <!-- derived: jobId, jobUUID from parent job; isLearning from which key it came under -->

```

## Error handling

- **Corrupt opportunity:** the parser logs it and skips it, stores every opportunity that did parse, then throws `JSONException`.
- **Corrupt payment unit:** the parser logs it and drops that unit; the rest of the job is kept.
- **Any other missing required key:** the whole opportunity fails to parse.
- **Empty response body:** the parser stores nothing and returns an empty list.
- **New opportunities stored:** the parser schedules a one-time fetch of release toggles.
